svg.title: half-fixed scan on prism-php/prism
svg.desc: Running npx half-fixed scan --group ToolMap on prism-php/prism lists hf-5505660: a fix made to the DeepSeek and OpenRouter tool maps in commit 9447c71 that the Groq, Mistral, xAI and Z tool maps never received. That gap is fixed in prism-php/prism#1038.
